svg.title: LIN TX Demo - Full Sequence From main() To USART2/LIN Bus

g.text: LIN TX Demo - Full Sequence From main() To USART2/LIN Bus
Application writes latest signal values into COM
- byte2..3 stay 0 unless app writes them
- byte1..2 stay 0 unless app writes them
1. Application never pushes LIN bytes directly to the driver.
2. Application only refreshes COM shadow buffers.
3. LinIf owns the bus schedule and decides when a frame may appear on LIN.
4. At slot time, LinIf pulls the freshest payload through PduR -> Com.
5. On the wire, a LIN frame is Break + Sync + PID + Data + Checksum.
6. USART2 serializes bytes, but electrical single-wire LIN still needs a LIN transceiver outside the MCU.
- LinIfTxPduId 0 -> LIN Frame ID 0x10 -> first sent byte after PID calc = 0x50
- LinIfTxPduId 1 -> LIN Frame ID 0x11 -> first sent byte after PID calc = 0x11
